notes: Strip d (x 4580-6769, plus overlap from 4280). Mostly open land, the John Douglas Co. and playing-card/printing works, Standard Oil Co. lot, Duck Creek and railroads. Big diagonal lettering 'EAST NORWOOD SUB.' and 'COOLEY'S HOMESTEAD' are subdivision/estate names, not streets. 'NORWOOD' and 'CINCINNATI' printed either side of Duck Creek Road are corporation labels for the CITY LIMITS line drawn inside the road. Band with dash-dot centreline running NE from the creek bridge (labelled 'L...&...') treated as railroad, not a street. Sycamore Street (centre about x 4200) lies outside the strip overlap. Duck Creek Road name read as 'DUCK CREEK' (printed in the road near y 5450) plus 'ROAD' (printed near y 3500).
